setlist.title: Beat It On Down The Line
Caution (Do Not Stop on the Tracks)

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (4 reviews): A high-energy jam emerges from space, applying jazz and classical principles to rock; The forty-five-minute performance reaches a new dimension of improvisation, requiring full attention [7][8][9][11]
- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): Pigpen runs with a mellow groove flawlessly in this first set performance [6]
- **Caution (Do Not Stop on the Tracks)** (1 review): Pigpen improvises wildly while Jerry accompanies, adding a humorous line about grease by the bed [5]

## The recordings

- **gd72-05-11.sbd.ashley-bertha.7364.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 34 songs; 218 min; rated 4.98/5 by 48 [1]
- **gd72-05-11.sbd.samaritano.9357.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 29 songs; 223 min; rated 4.44/5 by 34 [2]. Said about its sound: Jerry's guitar feeds back in the middle of the monster jam, creating a spacey, mysterious sound [13]
- **gd1972-05-11.sbd.giles.3830.shnf**: soundboard; 30 songs; 219 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- This was the final Caution and Who Do You Love performance for the late Pigpen [8]
- Pigpen's health was failing, yet the performance was incandescent and crackled like a thundercloud [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd72-05-11.sbd.ashley-bertha.7364.sbefail.shnf**: source: SBD>>MR>>DAT>>CDA>>SHN>>DAW(Bertha)>>SHN [1]. Also: Jay Ashley remastered the Master Reel source for this soundboard recording [1]
- **gd72-05-11.sbd.samaritano.9357.sbeok.shnf**: source: 10" MR@7.5ips->DAT>CDR [2]
- **gd1972-05-11.sbd.giles.3830.shnf**: transferred by Bill Giles; source: Discs 1 and 2 - SBD>MR>C>DAT>CDR>EAC>SHN Discs 3 and 4 - SBD>MR>??>FM>??>CDR>editing>CDR>EAC>SHN [3]. Also: A fadeout at the end of Rider is due to a reel flip; The Uncle John's Band sequence is less abrupt here than on the Storch master [3]
- Initial release in 2011 on Grateful Dead Records as a four CD set [21]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead of the Day: [Dead of the Day: May 11, 1972](https://gratefuldeadoftheday.com/05-11-1972/) [22]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 5/11/72 Grote Zaal - De Doelen, Rotterdam,… | Flickr](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26826835196/) [23]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26826835196/) [24]

claims.song: Caution (Do Not Stop on the Tracks)
claims.text: Pigpen improvises wildly while Jerry accompanies, adding a humorous line about grease by the bed
Pigpen runs with a mellow groove flawlessly in this first set performance
A high-energy jam emerges from space, applying jazz and classical principles to rock
The forty-five-minute performance reaches a new dimension of improvisation, requiring full attention
This was the final Caution and Who Do You Love performance for the late Pigpen
After Bill's drum solo, the jam becomes cacophonous and scary, resembling a devastating hurricane
Pigpen's health was failing, yet the performance was incandescent and crackled like a thundercloud
The performance is described as both sublime and mind-crunching, proving the band's seminal status
Jerry's guitar feeds back in the middle of the monster jam, creating a spacey, mysterious sound
Jay Ashley remastered the Master Reel source for this soundboard recording
A fadeout at the end of Rider is due to a reel flip
The Uncle John's Band sequence is less abrupt here than on the Storch master
Initial release in 2011 on Grateful Dead Records as a four CD set
